notes.title: Introducing the Eel Boss!
notes.content:
Hello friends! It's David from Brave Lunch with another great update to Blobkin. Let's get right to it:

 Added the Eel Boss! This fearsome menace can be encountered after the Oil Rig map, lurking deep below the depths in that mysterious hole in front of you. He'll require excellent aiming and dodging skills to survive.
 Polished off Red Tide mode, adding more enemies, waves, and power ups.
 Optimized all the map's shadow maps, ideally reducing a lot of processing overhead for GPUs.
 Fixed a bug where you could get stuck with just one enemy at a time attacking you, not a school/swarm.
 Fixed a bug where toxic guys were double counting your score and enemies killed.
 Reduced flashing of various particle fx that was giving players a headache; In particular the yellow effects. 


The Eel was a big bad we are really excited about showing to the world. I can't wait for you to try him! As always, leave feedback and comments below. Happy hunting :)

:David

notes.title: Updated to 1.1.2!
notes.content:
Hello friends! Lots of bug fixes in this one, let's get right to it:


 • The OilRig and Pirate Cove level blockers have been fixed. There was an issue where if you didn't build something in time, or if you built it too early, the game would not progress. This bug was squashed!

 • The Scalloper, end boss, would occasionally glitch out and not do anything. Turns out he was just dozing off while on the job. We've since spoken to his manager and adjusted his schedule - Scalloper will now correctly react to player's shots and play his mini cinematics so that the game can progress.

 • The Tutorial Balloons during the Tutorial and Coral Reef levels were not firing, occasionally not informing you how to build at all. This has been fixed! Turns out the balloons were hiding.

 • An issue with Virtual Desktop controllers being pitched too much was reduced by using tender love and care to ensure that they lock onto your hand nicely.


🥰

:David, co-creator

notes.title: Blobkin Blaster has Launched! 😄🐟🥽
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/5616230360e8bbec452cebdf03b450cbd0191490.gif

Hi everyone! I am so excited to announce that Blobkin Blaster has launched on Steam today! Woohoo! 

A couple of notes:

 There is a known issue with Virtual Desktop sound. To fix it, please see this post: https://steamcommunity.com/app/996580/discussions/0/1633040337746016228/ . The issue seems to be the way V.D. interprets Oculus devices. We're exploring what we can do on our side, but unfortunately this looks like a V.D. issue. Nonetheless, the link above should help fix it!

 Pitched controllers/angle is off. I got a few reports of this from users and I'm looking into it. If you have them, please let me know what headset, and if you're using something like Virtual Desktop or Link/Airlink.

 You may see occasional disconnects using Oculus Airlink on Quest 2. This is a known issue as Oculus' software is in beta. Just a heads up.

 Windows Mixed Reality, Lenovo and Cosmos headsets are unsupported, but I did program in their controls. If they don't work, please comment or send me an email (hi at bravelunch.com) and lets talk!


A Little Backstory
What started off as a fun experiment for LudumDare Gamejam blossomed into this wonderful experience learning about the underwater world, invasive species and VR.

Like most, the pandemic hit our little business hard (television and themepark graphics), and we found ourselves wondering what we were going to do next? It was not an easy time for anyone, but, we found hope in how much fun we had during the gamejam.

Did I mention my wife got pregnant!?

To celebrate, as best as we could, we took a small trip to Key West and discovered the coral reefs of Florida, I discovered that spearfishermen encourage you to hunt lionfish because they are threatening the native reef fish. Trash, like in all oceans, is also becoming a major problem for the sea life world. But there's hope! Little bacteria are slowly eating away at the plastic trash down below.

Now you can see where this is going.

With no real prospects of new work coming down, I took the team at Theory Studios on a journey that combined my love of the coral reefs, the interesting science that's growing at cleaning up the ocean, and infused it with all that great cartoony animation our studio is known for.

Along the way we decided to start up a new company, Brave Lunch, solely focused on games, and we even recruited some new friends to help us realize Blobkin Blaster.

In fact, I couldn't do it without the help and expertise of these 29 wonderful people, plus one baby manager who ensures no button goes unpressed.

Our game is short. It is hand crafted with love and dedication, with aim to make every moment as sweet as possible. However...

We have a new Boss and Expanded Red Tide (Endless) Mode Coming in September!

There are always things you want to add that can't get in there in time. An amazing cavern with a giant Eel will venture out later next month :)

-

On behalf of everyone at the studio, and all of our friends who contributed along the way, we hope you enjoy your dip into the undersea world with Blobkin. As always, if you have questions or comments feel free to leave them, or send us a quick email (hi at bravelunch.com).

Talk soon,

:David, co-founder of BraveLunch & Theory Studios
💙💧

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/e8f30caaa5ac330e9361078e3d6cef4e87eac651.gif

Welcome back to the reef, Captain!

Blobkins have been hard at work building the next iteration of Blobkin. We're really excited to share it with you in this upcoming Steam Next Fest Livestream!

Come meet the devs, talk about the mysteries of the deep, and see who can speedrun Blobkin the fastest!

We'll be streaming live, Saturday June 19 at 2pm Eastern (GMT-4)

Wait, What is Blobkin Blaster?
You are the Captain of the Blobkin, the mightiest, tiniest, defenders of the reef! Take command of your army in a fight for survival against ocean pollution and the defiled monsters of the deep. Collect Blobkins, build cannons and homes, and restore glory to your once beautiful ocean home.

Blobkins is a mix of a wave shooter and tower defense game, in VR. You play as an underwater diver who happened upon a curious group of tiny blue creatures in search of a hero to save the day. 

Will you be that hero?

notes.title: Big Beta Boost! Fixed Index controller + much more 😁
notes.content:
Hello friends, fam, and fellow fish. I know it's Labor Day, and that means parents watching the one-year old while more furious programming is done!

Lots of big changes:


 The Weapons now stick to your hands. No more dropping 😅
 New Skip Tutorial button!
 And Switch Weapon sign, in case you want to swap which is your dominant hand 👋
 Hold down the trigger to fire your blaster! That should ease those trigger fingers... 👆
 Fixed a lot of reloading bugs, but there may still be edge cases 🤔
 Waves now properly end if you lose 🌊
 Enemies may be harder. Still tweaking the attack rates. Please let me know what you think! 🐡
 New intro music! Caleb our composer improved the way it feels and blends into the battle music 🎵


But my favorite feature?

SMILING BLOBKIN!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/2788f2d1a8e95cb6507ba60ae8604a5928143c0a.gif

They actually were always meant to smile, they're helping you protect the reef of course, but for some reason the animation wasn't firing correctly. It's all fixed :)

notes.title: Beta Weekend Starts August 28th!
notes.content:
It has been a couple of months since our game update, but don’t worry, our little team is hard at work on Blobkin Blaster. We’ve taken the time to do a deep dive through all the code, removing legacy stuff from the gamejam that wasn’t up to performance. No one likes low FPS and crashes! Here's the kind of spaghetti we were dealing with (old on the right!).

We’ve also reworked all the game systems - this means adding new enemies, items and weapons should happen a lot faster now! Such as a new artillery cannon!

Now onto bigger news:
BETA WEEKEND is Coming! Happening August 28th
To sign up, please join our mailing list or Discord as we’ll hand out keys there :)


For now, please enjoy the current demo available! As always, email me with feedback and questions (david@bravelunch.com) or hit me up on Discord :D

💙💧

notes.title: An Update from the Reef #1 + Beta Weekend in August! 🤿🔫
notes.content:
Hello friends, fans (and hi mom!)

Our team over here at Brave Lunch is hungrily banging the keyboard at making Blobkin Blaster! We've got a new pistol blaster (your main starting weapon), plus we've got XP and level progression built in! Woohoo! Let's take a look:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/d304c154deb722d4a6e31b4fcd0e3967c712c2cc.gif

Plus, there's a new weapon we're working (potentially inspired by this). And we've been refining the wave mechanics so you don't get swarmed immediately.

Our goal is by the end of August to have a BETA WEEKEND! Play the first level, blow up monsters, and enjoy the calming rhythm of the sea :)

That is... until the clam boss shows up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/0d9f0abd7484369168d2c7b5734cbd4d1e84cb76.jpg

All of this has made us think, there should be a new genre of game out there.. SCUBA Shooter! It's like an FPS, but with underwater physics!

See you at the reef real soon. 💙💧

-
